note: Private campground at 130 Wilson Rd near Wellsboro (Tioga Co), on the East Rim of the PA Grand Canyon with a trail from the campground to the overlook level at Leonard Harrison State Park; close to the Pine Creek Rail Trail. Wooded sites with electric, electric/water and full hookups for rigs up to a 45-ft motorhome, plus primitive tent sites and glamping cabins; bath house with flush toilets and showers, laundry, store, dump station. Open April 15 - October 31; book online or by phone up to a year ahead. 2026 rates from $50 (electric) to $65 (full hookup) plus a $20 management fee per stay. --Claude
summary: Confirmed fees $50-65 (2026 rates, electric to full hookup, $20 management fee), water + sewer, open Apr 15 - Oct 31 (now dated), dump; added rigs to 45 ft, showers/flush toilets/laundry/store/Wi-Fi hotspot, online booking on Guesty up to a year ahead. Not stated: amperage, site count, pull-throughs (the Guesty engine is a client-side app). Proposed a note fixing the stale 'No on-site water' line.
